content: OWASP: CSP should be delivered as a real HTTP response header (not meta tag) for full feature support, and is defense-in-depth on top of - not a replacement for - safe output-encoding practices (Phoenix/HEEx auto-escaping already covers most XSS by default). OWASP recommends HSTS max-age of 2 years (63072000s) with includeSubDomains once a site is confidently HTTPS-only forever - caution that a very long max-age can lock out users if the cert/domain setup ever needs to fall back to HTTP, so a shorter initial rollout value (e.g. 6-12 months) ramping up over time is a common risk-managed approach for a solo-dev site with no HTTP fallback plan tested yet.
